{{Quote|He has been here nearly thirty years and has tried not just to get along in the community but to become a part of it.|[[Snaplaunce]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
'''Cagaran Wei''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who lived in [[Hweg Shul]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. For twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]], he was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a [[Cagaran Wei's wife|woman]] jeweler who [[Death/Legends|died]] in a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] accident. A [[Latecomer]], Doctor Wei disappeared inexplicably in [[44 ABY]] without a trace. Later he was found [[Death/Legends|dead]] at site of [[Rock ivory processing plant]] by [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]].
